transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. Let's get started with the 0700 power-control board meeting. We've got four activities to schedule across four two-hour blocks today: the generator load test, clinic refrigeration transfer, communications-battery recharge, and water-point pumping. The main generator can only support one at a time, so each activity gets its own block. Before I publish the final schedule, I need each section to report any changes or constraints from your end. Who wants to go first?
